corrections.issue: WSL transcript result verification freshness checks (using stat command) timed out due to slow network file sharing access.

source_material.description: Standard multi-scene video sequence with speaker overlap and visual objects.

failed_attempts: Attempted to increase global timeout of ZenML orchestration (increased boot latency without fixing underlying filesystem lag).
corrections.solution: Refactored stat/freshness verification in client/WSL bridge calls to directly check file presence and comparison via native PowerShell and Go bindings rather than executing slow subprocess stat commands.
corrections.notable_results: Live witness rerun of scenes 18-25 verified 100% completion of WSL transcription with zero visual-only fallbacks.

variables_changed.name: wsl_file_access_method
variables_changed.after: native UNC test-path and file comparison

corrections.issue: Headless web client hangs in background shells because Invoke-WebRequest initializes the Internet Explorer engine, blocking on first-run configuration prompts.

source_material.description: Staging downloader script for offline resources.

failed_attempts: Tried using raw Invoke-WebRequest without additional parameters.
corrections.solution: Used .NET System.Net.WebClient for headless downloading, bypassing the IE rendering engine entirely.
corrections.notable_results: Headless WebClient downloads successfully in headless/CI runner environments.

corrections.issue: SourceForge and NSSM.cc block standard automation/python User-Agents with 503 or redirect loops.

source_material.description: Staging downloader script for offline resources.

failed_attempts: Used default User-Agent strings which resulted in HTML redirection payload size checks failing.
corrections.solution: Implemented a fallback retry mechanism changing User-Agent headers dynamically from 'Wget' to 'Mozilla/5.0' to force direct asset download redirection.
corrections.notable_results: Headless downloading of nsis and nssm packages succeeds reliably.

variables_changed.name: user_agent_header
variables_changed.after: Dynamic fallback from Wget to Mozilla/5.0

corrections.issue: Multi-line PowerShell commands inside CMD/BAT files break if they contain parentheses because the CMD parser mistakenly treats them as batch blocks.
failed_attempts: Attempted escaping parentheses with caret (^) in CMD string block.
corrections.solution: Extracted the multi-line PowerShell logic out of build_installer.bat and into dedicated, isolated preflight_check.ps1 and generate_manifest.ps1 scripts.
corrections.notable_results: Zero CMD string evaluation syntax failures.

corrections.issue: With $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop', calling Write-Error within a try-catch block throws a terminating exception that is captured by its own catch block, creating self-masking success states.
failed_attempts: Wrapping Write-Error in try-catch to log it gracefully.
corrections.solution: Set state tracking variables inside try-catch, and throw or call a dedicated Fail-Build function outside the block to ensure exit codes propagate to CMD parent.
corrections.notable_results: Precise propagation of error codes (e.g. 10, 11, 12, 13) to parent scripts.
